Extracts full Open Graph metadata from a page

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using Crawlberg;

var engine = CrawlbergConverter.CreateEngine(null);
var url = "https://example.com";
var result = await CrawlbergConverter.ScrapeAsync(engine, url);
Console.WriteLine(result.StatusCode);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.OgTitle);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.OgType);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.OgImage);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.OgDescription);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.Title);
```
